column6: Exercise fails when worked toward the natural goal: proving counter = 2 needs auxiliary variables in both CSL and rely-guarantee (x:=x+1 || x:=x+1 classic). Added that qualifier. Older text: Explainer calls list(x,len) higher-order because it "quantifies over other predicates" (it does not); Q1 answer "Q * R*" is muddled; Q4 deny-guarantee description (lower/upper bounds) does not match Dodds et al. 2009; Explainer says "exactly 10 credits" vs Q3 "at most".
Worked: swap proof; Hoare-logic array-update rule forces the x = y case split; frame z -> c is valid.
Older text: Q3 explanation "2^(n choose 2) cases" overstates aliasing cases (transitivity limits them to set partitions).
Style/clarity only: "one branch" offering two options changed to "one branching point". Worked: server &{add: ?Int.?Int.!Int.end, quit: end}, client dual is a selection.
Worked: abstraction gives conflict clause not(x>2) or not(x<1), then UNSAT; Nelson-Oppen derives x = y, EUF gets f(x)=f(y), conflict.

unknown gives no evidence for either answer is an overstated absolute (e.g. incomplete quantifier reasoning can return a candidate model); softened to "does not settle the question". Older text: Q3 true-false "can always decide QF formulas in supported theories" = true is wrong as stated (QF nonlinear integer arithmetic is supported and undecidable; its own explanation says so); Explainer "minimal unsatisfiable subset" overstates (conflict clauses need not be minimal).
Worked: k unrolled ifs give 2^k paths; merging gives one state with nested ite for count.

Older text: TriforceAFL is AFL-based kernel fuzzing in QEMU, not whole-system symbolic execution (Core Idea, Explainer, tool list); Q1 answer describes merging as OR of constraints only, which the new bullet 1 correctly contradicts.
Worked: error path 2b = a and a > b + 10 gives b > 10; y = 11, x = 22 satisfies it (22 > 21).

Belief "concolic covers more paths" is often true in practice, so the correction did not refute it. Reworded belief to "explores every path that pure symbolic execution would". Older text: SAGE "one-third of all security bugs during Windows 7 development" drops the qualifier "found by file fuzzing".
Worked: all paths satisfy F G p; on s0^omega no state satisfies AG p, so AF AG p fails.
Belief's rationale ("Because LTL ranges over all paths, EF p = F p") is self-defeating; trimmed to "The CTL formula EF p can be written in LTL as F p". Correction (EF p not LTL-expressible) is right.

Second loop was underspecified (no guard, no j >= 0 start), so the bounded-below check could not be worked. Replaced with explicit while (i > 0) loop with nondeterministic non-negative reset; verified no linear ranking function exists and (i, j) works.
Older text: Core Idea "vast majority of practical loops" and Q2 explanation "pathological programs rarely appear" are overclaims.
Worked: swap wp chain gives y = b and x = a; conditional reduces to true.
